privacy.title: Your biometric data
privacy.howItWorksBody: When you tap "Find my photos", your selfie is sent securely to AWS Rekognition (region eu-west-1) for a single face-similarity search against the photos of that event. Once the search completes, your selfie is discarded — Photo Markt does not retain it and AWS Rekognition does not store it as part of this flow.
privacy.whatWeStoreBullet1: We do not store your selfies.
privacy.whatWeStoreBullet2: We do not store biometric embeddings derived from you.
privacy.whatWeStoreBullet3: We do record that you performed searches (timestamp + IP) for rate-limiting and abuse prevention, but not the content of those searches.
privacy.gdprBody: You have the right to access, correct, and request deletion of any personal data we hold about you. Because we don't persist your selfie or biometric data from a face search, the only relevant records are search-event logs (rate-limit telemetry). For any data request or question about this processing, contact us at

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: Photo Markt is a marketplace that connects sports photographers with the people they photograph. This policy explains what personal data we collect, why we collect it, who we share it with, and the rights you have over it. We collect the minimum we need to run the marketplace.
privacyPolicy.contactBody: For any privacy question, or to exercise any of your rights, email us at

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: We collect the following personal data, depending on how you use Photo Markt:
bullets: Account details from Google when you sign in (name, email address, and profile picture).
Profile information you add, such as your display name and username.
Photos that photographers upload to their events, and the cover images shown publicly.
Order and purchase history, including which photos you bought.
Feedback and support messages you send us, including any screenshot you attach.
Limited technical data — your IP address and timestamps — used to keep sessions secure and to rate-limit abuse.

sections.heading: How we use your information
sections.body: We use your data to provide and improve the service:
bullets: To create and secure your account and keep you signed in.
To let photographers publish events and sell photos, and to let buyers find and purchase them.
To process payments and pay photographers their earnings.
To send transactional emails such as purchase confirmations.
To respond to your feedback and support requests.
To prevent fraud and abuse, and to comply with our legal obligations.

sections.heading: Face search and biometric data
sections.body: Our optional "find my photos" feature lets you upload a selfie to find pictures of yourself at an event. Your selfie is sent to AWS Rekognition (region eu-west-1) for a single similarity search and is then discarded — we do not store your selfie or any biometric data derived from it. To make this matching possible, faces detected in photographers' event photos are indexed in AWS Rekognition; we keep only the returned face identifiers mapped to the photos, never raw biometric templates. Events involving minors are excluded from this feature.

sections.heading: Event photos
sections.body: Original photos are stored privately. Public previews are watermarked and reduced in quality; the full-resolution original is only made available through a short-lived link after a confirmed purchase. We never expose the original storage location publicly.

sections.heading: Payments
sections.body: Payments are processed by Stripe. We do not see or store your full card number — Stripe handles card data directly as a PCI-compliant provider. We retain order records (amounts, status, and Stripe references) to fulfil purchases, pay photographers, and meet accounting obligations.

sections.heading: Service providers we share data with
sections.body: We share data only with the providers that power the service, and only as needed to run it:
bullets: Supabase — database, authentication, and photo storage.
Stripe — payment processing and photographer payouts.
AWS Rekognition — face matching for the optional photo-search feature.
Resend — transactional email delivery.
Google — sign-in (OAuth).
Our hosting and background-job providers, which process data on our behalf.

sections.heading: Cookies and sessions
sections.body: We use strictly necessary cookies to keep you signed in and to secure your session. We do not use advertising cookies or sell your data to advertisers.

sections.heading: Data retention
sections.body: We keep your account and order data for as long as your account is active and as long as we need it to meet legal and accounting obligations. Selfies used for face search are not retained. You can ask us to delete your account and associated personal data at any time.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to:
bullets: Access the personal data we hold about you.
Correct inaccurate data.
Request deletion of your data.
Object to or restrict certain processing.
Request a copy of your data in a portable format.

sections.heading: Children
sections.body: Photo Markt is not intended for children. Events that may involve minors are excluded from face-search indexing, and we do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If you believe a child's data has been shared with us, contact us and we will remove it.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this policy as the product evolves. When we make material changes, we will update the date at the top of this page.

aboutPage.title: About us
aboutPage.intro: Photo Markt is a marketplace for sports event photography. We connect the photographers who capture race days, matches, and competitions with the athletes who want those photos of themselves — and we make finding, buying, and getting paid for them simple.
aboutPage.contactBody: Have a question, a partnership idea, or feedback? We would love to hear from you at

sections.heading: Our mission
sections.body: Sports photos used to be hard to find and harder to buy. Photographers shot thousands of frames and athletes rarely saw the ones of themselves. Photo Markt closes that gap: we give photographers a place to publish their work and get paid fairly, and we give athletes a fast way to find and own their moment.

sections.heading: What we do
sections.body: Photographers create an event, upload their photos, and set a price. Athletes browse the event, find the photos they appear in, and buy high-resolution copies. We handle the storage, the watermarked previews, the payments, and the payouts — so both sides can focus on the photo, not the logistics.

sections.heading: For photographers
sections.body: Turn your event shoots into a storefront in minutes.
bullets: Create public or private events and upload your photos in bulk.
Let athletes find themselves instantly with AI-powered face search.
Set your own price per photo and keep most of every sale.
Get paid directly to your bank through Stripe, with no payout minimums.

sections.heading: For athletes
sections.body: Find the photos of your big day without scrolling through thousands of frames.
bullets: Browse the events you took part in.
Upload a selfie to instantly surface the photos you appear in.
Buy clean, high-resolution copies — yours to keep and share.
Keep every purchase organized in your library.

termsOfService.title: Terms of Service
termsOfService.intro: These Terms of Service govern your use of Photo Markt, a marketplace that connects sports photographers with the people they photograph. By creating an account, browsing events, uploading photos, or buying photos, you agree to these Terms. Please read them together with our Privacy Policy.
termsOfService.contactBody: For any question about these Terms, email us at

sections.heading: Acceptance of these Terms
sections.body: By accessing or using Photo Markt you confirm that you can form a binding contract and that you accept these Terms and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the service. If you use Photo Markt on behalf of an organization, you confirm that you are authorized to bind that organization.

sections.heading: Accounts and roles
sections.body: You sign in with Google and can act as a photographer, as talent (the person photographed), or switch between both roles from your dashboard. You are responsible for keeping your account secure and for all activity that happens under it.
bullets: Photographer: create events, upload and manage photos, track sales and earnings, and manage your payout account.
Talent: browse events, find photos of yourself, and purchase them.
Provide accurate information, keep it up to date, and do not share your account with others.

sections.heading: Photographer subscriptions and payouts
sections.body: Photographers can use Photo Markt on a free plan or on a paid subscription. Each plan has a monthly price and a commission rate on sales, shown on our pricing page and in your billing settings. Paid subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled, and you can manage or cancel yours at any time from your settings.
bullets: Commission is deducted from each sale according to your active plan at the time of the sale.
Payouts are sent to your connected Stripe account; you must complete Stripe onboarding to receive funds.
Photo Markt absorbs the Stripe Connect transfer fee, so you receive the net amount promised for your plan.

sections.heading: Photographer content, ownership and licenses
sections.body: You keep ownership of the photos you upload. By uploading, you grant Photo Markt a non-exclusive, worldwide license to host, process, watermark, resize, display previews of, and deliver your photos as needed to operate the marketplace and complete sales. You are responsible for the content you upload and for holding the rights and permissions needed to sell it.
bullets: Only upload photos you took or are otherwise authorized to sell.
Obtain any consent required from the people depicted, and follow the rules that apply to events that may involve minors.
Do not upload unlawful, infringing, or harmful content.

sections.heading: Buying photos and your license to use them
sections.body: When you purchase a photo, you receive a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use that photo for your own personal, non-commercial purposes. The photographer keeps the copyright unless they agree otherwise with you directly, and commercial use requires their separate permission.
bullets: Previews are watermarked and reduced in quality; the full-resolution file is delivered only after a confirmed purchase, through a short-lived link.
Do not resell, redistribute, or sublicense purchased photos.

sections.heading: Pricing, payments and taxes
sections.body: Prices are shown before you pay. Payments are processed by Stripe, and we do not store your full card details. You are responsible for any taxes that apply to your purchases or, for photographers, to your earnings. Photo Markt charges a platform fee and, where applicable, the plan commission, as described on our pricing page.

sections.heading: Refunds
sections.body: Photos are digital goods delivered immediately after payment, so purchases are generally final once the full-resolution file has been made available. If a photo is faulty, was charged in error, or there is another problem with your order, contact us and we will review it in good faith and in line with applicable consumer law.

sections.heading: AI photo search and biometric data
sections.body: The optional "find my photos" feature lets you upload a selfie to find pictures of yourself at an event. Your selfie is sent to AWS Rekognition for a single similarity search and is not stored by Photo Markt. Face indexing is enabled per event by the photographer and is excluded for events that may involve minors. By using this feature you consent to the processing described in our Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
sections.body: To keep Photo Markt safe for everyone, you agree not to:
bullets: Upload content you do not have the right to sell, or that infringes someone else's rights.
Upload unlawful, harmful, harassing, or sexually exploitative content, including any content that depicts minors inappropriately.
Access photos, accounts, or data you are not authorized to access, or bypass watermarks, signed links, or other security controls.
Scrape, copy, or redistribute content from the platform, or interfere with its normal operation.
Use the service to break the law or to infringe the privacy or intellectual property of others.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
sections.body: Photo Markt, including its name, logo, software, and design, belongs to us or our licensors and is protected by intellectual-property laws. These Terms do not grant you any right to our trademarks or platform beyond using the service as intended. Photos remain the property of their respective photographers.

sections.heading: Disclaimers and limitation of liability
sections.body: Photo Markt is provided "as is" and "as available," without warranties of any kind to the extent permitted by law. We do not guarantee that face search will find every photo of you, or that the service will be uninterrupted or error-free. To the maximum extent permitted by law, Photo Markt is not liable for indirect or consequential damages, and our total liability for any claim is limited to the amount you paid through the platform in the twelve months before the claim. Nothing in these Terms limits rights that cannot be limited under applicable law, including mandatory consumer rights.

sections.heading: Suspension and termination
sections.body: You can stop using Photo Markt and close your account at any time. We may suspend or terminate access if you breach these Terms, misuse the service, or where we are required to by law. Some records, such as completed orders, may be retained as described in our Privacy Policy and as required for legal and accounting purposes.

sections.heading: Changes to these Terms
sections.body: We may update these Terms as the product evolves. When we make material changes, we will update the date at the top of this page. Continuing to use Photo Markt after changes take effect means you accept the updated Terms.

sections.heading: Governing law
sections.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the country in which the operator of Photo Markt is established, without affecting any mandatory consumer-protection rights you have where you live. If you are a consumer in the EU, you keep the protection of the mandatory provisions of your country of residence. The specific operating entity and governing jurisdiction will be confirmed before public launch.

faqsTalent.question: How do I find photos from my event?
faqsTalent.answer: Use the Explore page to search by event name, location, or date. Once you find your event, browse the gallery or upload a selfie to let AI matching find photos of you automatically.

faqsTalent.question: My download isn't working — what do I do?
faqsTalent.answer: First, check your Orders page to confirm the payment completed. If the order shows as paid but the download fails, try clearing your browser cache or using a different browser. Still stuck? Submit a ticket below.

faqsTalent.question: Can I request a refund?
faqsTalent.answer: If a photo's quality is significantly different from its watermarked preview, submit a ticket below with your order ID and we'll review it. Refunds are handled case by case by our team.

faqsTalent.question: How do I hide my profile from photographers?
faqsTalent.answer: Go to Profile → Privacy and turn off your public profile. Your purchases stay intact; photographers just can't find your profile directly.

faqsTalent.question: Why can't I see all photos from my event?
faqsTalent.answer: Photographers control photo visibility. Some photos may be set to private, may still be processing, or may have been removed. Contact the photographer through the event page if you believe photos are missing.

faqsPhotographer.question: When will I get paid for my sales?
faqsPhotographer.answer: Payouts are sent automatically after each sale through Stripe Connect — there's no minimum balance or waiting period on our side. Once Stripe releases the funds, your bank typically posts them within 2–5 business days. Connect your payout account in Settings → Payout profile.

faqsPhotographer.question: Why did my photo upload fail?
faqsPhotographer.answer: Common causes: files larger than 50 MB, an unsupported format (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIF, AVIF and GIF are accepted), or a slow or interrupted connection. Try re-uploading in smaller batches. If it keeps failing, include any error message in a support ticket.

faqsPhotographer.question: How do I set pricing for an event?
faqsPhotographer.answer: Open the event from your Events page and set the price per photo in the event settings. You can adjust it at any time before sharing the event.

faqsPhotographer.question: How does watermarking work?
faqsPhotographer.answer: When watermarking is enabled on an event, Photo Markt overlays a tiled watermark on every preview image. Buyers receive clean, un-watermarked files after purchase. Toggle watermarking per event in the event settings.

faqsPhotographer.question: How do I report a copyright issue?
faqsPhotographer.answer: Submit a ticket below with the photo URL, evidence of ownership, and your contact details. We review reports promptly and will remove content pending investigation when needed.
